notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, targeting any target.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
